newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday April 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday April 18.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* The centre-left government won a confidence vote in the Chamber of Deputies (lower house) which it had called to ram through a long-stalled draft law on civil service reform. The cabinet agenda also included a decree on Italy's involvement in Albania (all).
* Franco Marini, leader of the centrist Popular Party (PPI), met prime minister Romano Prodi and said he was determined to get Italy into Europe's single currency (all).

* Italian marines on a multinational relief mission to Albania reached the key rebel stronghold of Vlore, as diplomatic efforts moved forward to restore order in the anarchic nation. Four Italian coastguard vessels left the southeastern port of Brindisi to patrol Albanian waters in an attempt to dissuade illegal emigrants from trying to cross the Adriatic (all).
* The lower house of parliament will start discussing the 1997 mini-budget on April 28 (all).

* According to European Commission forecasts reported today by Italian newspapers, Italy would remain outside the criteria needed to participate in the start of Europe's Economic and Monetary Union as its deficit in 1997 is set to be 3.2 to 3.3 percent of Gross Domestic Product (all).
* Italian energy group Edison announced a 1996 consolidated net profit of 370 billion lire, up 38 percent from 1995 net profit of 268 billion lire (Il Sole 24 Ore).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
